sentences.text: Smt. Priya Gupta vs Anuj Sahu on 13 December, 2023

1
 
 High Court Of Chhattisgarh, Bilaspur
 Tpc No. 161 of 2023

Smt. Priya Gupta W/o Anuj Sahu Aged About 29 Years D/o Sushil Kumar Gupta,
 Occupation Teacher/Lecturer R/o Village Baijnathpur, P.S. And Tahsil Bhaiyathan,
 District Surajpur (C.G.)

----
 Versus  Anuj Sahu S/o Shri Sheet Prasad Sahu Aged About 29 Years R/o Village Jashpur  Road Kansabel, Tahsil Kansabel, District Jashpur (C.G.)

---- Res  (Cause Title is taken from Case Information System)
 --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
For Appellant : Shri Ashok Kumar Shukla, Advocate.
For Respondent : None appears though served.

This petition has been filed for transfer of Civil Suit No. 47A of 2023 pending before the learned Family Court, Jashpur, which was filed for dissolution of marriage under Section 13 of the Hindu Marriage Act to the learned Family Court, Ambikapur.
2. Learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that the marriage between the parties was solemnized on 16.6.2021.
The petitioner is working as Guest Teacher at Baijnathpur, Block Bhaiyathan, District Surajpur and distance between Jashpur and Bhaiyathan is more than 200 km.

He would further submit that two cases are pending at Ambikapur; one application moved under Section 125 of Cr.P.C. before the learned Family Court, Ambikapur and the other is criminal case registered against the respondent under Section 498A of the IPC before the learned Judicial Magistrate First Class, Ambikapur.

He would further submit that the respondent has threatened for dire consequences if the petitioner would go to Jashpur to attend the Court proceedings, therefore,
the case may be transferred from Jashpur to Ambikapur.
3. There is no representation on behalf of the respondent even after service of notice.

4. Taking into consideration the grounds raised by learned counsel for the petitioner, this Court is inclined to allow the petition and Civil Suit No. 47A of 2023 pending before the Family Court,
Jashpur is transferred to learned Family Court, Ambikapur.

Learned Family Court, Jashpur is directed to transmit the records of Civil Suit No. 47A of 2023 to the learned Family Court,
Ambikapur.

Smt. Priya Gupta vs Anuj Sahu on 13 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/70798998/
1 5.
Accordingly, this petition stands disposed of.

Sd/-
